value: Module route_segments.py. normalize_segment is the stable validation helper with unchanged semantics. Round 0 targeted price_segment under contracts that remain binding; this round must preserve the actual current code and those contracts (not redefine or weaken them): dep-normalize-v1 (scope price-quote, required — price_segment validates only via normalize_segment and propagates its None) and round-half-up (global, required — every fractional-cent monetary result rounds to the nearest whole cent, exact half-cent up). Current target combine_segments(segments): returns None unless the input is a nonempty list. Rule dep-normalize-v2 (scope combine-legs, required): each element is normalized exclusively by calling normalize_segment with no re-checking of its own; any element normalizing to None makes the whole call return None. Rule merge-core (scope combine-legs, required): merge only adjacent legs sharing both mode and connection (first dest equals second origin), chain runs, preserve order, sum minutes and fare_cents. Standing rule merge-mode-scope-v1 (global, required): no feature ever merges legs across modes, here or in anything built later. Output is exactly {legs, leg_count, total_minutes, total_fare_cents}.

Module route_segments.py. normalize_segment is the stable validation helper with unchanged semantics. Rounds 0 and 1 targeted price_segment and combine_segments under contracts that remain binding; this round must preserve the actual current code and those contracts (not redefine or weaken them): dep-normalize-v1 (scope price-quote), round-half-up (global), and dep-normalize-v2 plus merge-core (scope combine-legs — combine_segments normalizes only via the helper and merges only adjacent same-mode connected legs, chaining runs in order). The blanket no-cross-mode rule has been changed by the user: rule merge-mode-scope-v1 is retired; current rule merge-mode-scope-v2 (scope itinerary-summary, required) mandates cross-mode merging only inside build_itinerary, while combine_segments keeps its same-mode-only behavior. Current target build_itinerary(request): return None unless request is a dict with exactly keys traveler (nonempty, non-whitespace string) and segments. Rule dep-normalize-v3 (scope itinerary-summary, required): build_itinerary must run combine_segments on segments and quote each final leg with price_segment, and None from either must propagate as None for the whole call. build_itinerary then folds consecutive legs whenever a leg's origin equals the accumulated leg's dest, even across modes, keeping the earlier leg's mode and origin, taking the later dest, summing fare_cents, and summing minutes plus 7 transfer minutes when modes differ. Because folding keeps the earlier mode, a folded walk-mode leg carrying nonzero fare (for example a walk-then-rail chain whose rail fare lands on it) is rejected by the fixed helper when priced, so the whole call returns None rather than a priced quote. Quote each final leg via price_segment (None anywhere makes the whole result None) and output exactly {traveler, leg_count, legs, total_minutes, quote_cents}.

build_itinerary must return None unless the request is a dict with exactly the keys traveler and segments and traveler is a nonempty string that is not all whitespace; it must run combine_segments on segments and quote every resulting leg with price_segment, and None from either must propagate as None for the whole call.
